posts.title: Jungle Jim’s: Apes Playing Poker
posts.description: Jungle Jim’s , the destination grocery store/amusement park increases its zaniness even more by including a large mural of Jim the Wizard himself playing poker with a variety of primates. No aces are being passed under the table, but a large collection of bananas graces the felt top. posts.title: Cassius Coolidge Featured in History Podcast
posts.description: Stuff You Missed in History Class podcast recently featured in episode on Cassius Coolidge and Dogs Playing Poker. Head on over for some great audio based information on the greatest artist in history.

Neuman sitting around a poker table with some pooch players, ala A Friend in Need .
